S.FORM: alang Bacingul ga niya mki sku Taitung Keng atu Umitan go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 67 buwan, 274 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 96% kyan ku 263 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 4% kyan ku 11 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Bunun 84%, Amis 1%, Puyuma 1%, binah lihuyan s'uli 9%. maki qu ngasal bziran. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Bacingul hya' ga Ku'ang sang go'. tay 'zil na Bacingul hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkyahu' na Bacingul hya' ga Yanping. tay mkraya' na Bacingul hya' ga Kanahcian. rekisi kayal kyokay maki 2 kyokay. ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan qalang Bacingul ga ungat pqwasan biru. tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh hmgiru lmosay
S.PHON: alaŋ βa[ʦ|ʨ]iŋul ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku taituŋ keŋ atu umitan ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa βunun ** ami[s|ɕ] * pujuma * βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na βa[ʦ|ʨ]iŋul ħjaʔ ɣa kuʔaŋ [s|ɕ]aŋ ɣoʔ taj ʔzil na βa[ʦ|ʨ]iŋul ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkjaħuʔ na βa[ʦ|ʨ]iŋul ħjaʔ ɣa janpiŋ taj mkrajaʔ na βa[ʦ|ʨ]iŋul ħjaʔ ɣa kanaħ[ʦ|ʨ]ian reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj maki * kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan qalaŋ βa[ʦ|ʨ]iŋul ɣa uŋat pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ ħmɣiru lmo[s|ɕ]aj
